title: Ink Wash Painting — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Ink branch becomes a network
scenes.purpose: Show a single idea (an ink touchdown) growing into a connected system using Chinese ink-painting construction order on cool dawn xuan paper.
visuals: Cool grey-white xuan paper with stationary fibres
Root ink dot with diluted bloom
Single dry-brush branch stroke lower-left to upper-right
Mid-grey wash and stippled granular root mass
Pale cool distant ranges lower right
Five twigs ending in ink clusters with bloom halos

beats.development: Ink touches down at the root, the ground contours are brushed in, and the main branch begins one continuous dry-brush stroke while the title resolves from blur.
The branch finishes, the stippled root mass fills from summit down, pale distant ranges recede behind it, and twigs draw out toward the nodes. The subtitle sharpens.
Ink clusters land at the twig tips with diluted blooms, and faint threads connect the nodes into a system.
The blooms settle by 2.6s, and the whole painting and copy hold for reading.

findings: Copy is fully sharp by 1.45s and stays legible through 3s.
All motion is settled by 2.6s, so the composition is static from 2.7s onward.
justifiedHolds: 2.3–3.0s: a final reading hold on the completed painting and copy.

notes: No motion references selected; the scene uses style-native brush construction.
Background is scene-dependent cool xuan paper #E7EAE7; ink is #242724.
